Episode 244. Ambush on the Jekmyeong Tribe (3)
"Damn, those flying fortresses I saw in Meisil…"
The feeling was completely different from when I encountered them in Meisil. At that time, Jin was with me, so I felt no great excitement, even facing the grandeur of the flying fortress.
But now, Jin is gone, and the enemy Cheonwang Shimat is pressing on her.
The flying fortresses looked like wings of Shimat. Pibil and Patil were about to target Luna without an inch of error, even while the two were fighting in close combat.
Crash-!
Tetalon slammed down on Luna. Luna blocked it by holding Crantel horizontally, but her stance crumbled as the ground gave way beneath her.

However, at that moment, Luna rolled her right foot. The ground sank with the impact, Shimat's body floated in the air for a moment, and in that state, she could not make an additional attack on Luna, even if she tried.
It should have been that way.
But Luna nearly had her heart pierced by a suddenly advancing blade.
"Ho-ho, you avoided that?"
The blade grazed Luna's shoulder. How Shimat had continued her attack, Luna realized in the next moment.
'The enemy brainwave…!'
Pibil and Patil, the enemy brainwaves sent from the flying fortress, assisted Shimat in regaining her stance at that moment.
Shimat stood on a red plate formed by the enemy brainwaves. Therefore, only Luna fell into the pit created by the shockwave.
She had never experienced or even imagined this kind of combat support.
Shimat even seemed very familiar with it. In fact, since the Sun War era, she had preferred to fight strong opponents in conjunction with flying fortresses, so she would never lose.
"Huh? Creating not just artillery support, but even a place to step on? Isn't that cheating?"
"Where's cheating in war, Baekgyeong? Even the master is said to have no sense of humor."
"Yeah, the master is indeed interesting."
Just as Luna was stepping to the left to get out of the pit, another red plate appeared right in front of her.
Of course, the flying fortress could not only assist Shimat's movement but also obstruct the opponent's.
"Damn!"
Luna, without panicking, split the red plate with Crantel. The plate collapsed easily, but the problem was that it kept reappearing without a break.
Any small movement to remove the plates created openings, and Shimat's sword unfailingly came flying in. If she dodged the sword, the precise bombardment from the flying fortress struck Luna's back.
"Are you sure you're human? You're withstanding the bombardment with your bare body, without any shields."
Though not deep, there were already over ten cuts and burst wounds on her body.
Hot blood trickled down her back. The heightened senses became even clearer, and her eyes seemed to suck in everything they saw.
At last, Luna was acutely aware of the 'crisis.'
'Ah... Is this what it feels like to really be on the brink of death?'
The crisis, deeper and more overwhelming than when she roamed the Black Sea with Sirion and the expeditionary force, was closing in on her.
"Why are you so surprised by this? My sibling is even tougher than me."
"Jin Runecandle?"
"No, it's Runetia. It's probably meaningless for you to know anyway."
"You're speaking of Runecandle's third generation. Why is it meaningless?"

Creak-! Luna kicked forward with her right foot and shattered the red plate. As Shimate had been doing all along, he swung Tetalon into the gap, but Luna caught his blade with her left hand and struck his head with Crantel.
Shimate also caught the blade of Crantel with his hand. Blood flowed from Luna's hand, while Shimate's hand was not cut at all.
"Because I've decided to kill you. With my whole life... that means, you don't have much longer to live."
Madness.
The moment Shimate locked eyes with Luna, he noticed the deep and dark madness within them. And that it was not something Luna had always had, but a temperament that had just ignited like a flame.
At the same time, Shimate suddenly felt something sharp flying towards his side.
'The old man?'
Still holding Luna's sword, Shimate naturally assumed that it was a sneak attack by Eliot, who had been hiding somewhere.
'I thought he was just hiding because he was so weakened, but daring to come and stab me directly...'
As he turned his head thinking so, what Shimate faced was not Eliot. Nor was it the blue energy he used.
A red, flickering energy, like the energy of the red giants, was stabbing into his side like a sword.
It was Luna's red power.
'How?'

Unexpectedly attacked, Shimate easily turned his body and brushed aside both Luna and the red power. Luna was thrown back by the recoil, but the red power didn't completely disperse; it momentarily lost its blade shape and aimed at Shimate once more.
"A psychokinetic sword, we called it that in our time. It's somewhat strange in form, but I didn't know you could use something like this."
"Well, I've just decided to kill you."
It was the first time Shimate seemed truly surprised. Awakening during a battle is common, but suddenly acquiring a specific skill is rare.
'...It's not a psychokinetic sword! It was just a manifestation of the red power through her killing intent. Usually, this would lead to losing one's sanity, but she seems fine.'
Luna was barely holding on to her sanity. If she let her guard down for even a moment, she felt she would be consumed by madness and become a beast.
On the one hand, she was enjoying that state. The mindset of dedicating herself to killing the opponent had dyed her with a simple and primal pleasure.
It felt as if she had become the old Yona who couldn't control her spirit. Luna, not even knowing that her body was getting hurt, was rushing towards Shimat.
"Die!"
Luna was laughing. The enemy leaders looking down at the battlefield from the aerial fortress were shivering at the sight of Luna charging like a madwoman.
Even though Shimat and the aerial fortress were an infinitely safe barrier, they swallowed hard.

However, Shimat deflected Luna's attack as if a skilled trainer was handling a wild beast. Although Krantel had become more ferocious, it was not enough to penetrate Shimat and the aerial fortress's defenses.
A power that transcends fate.

Facing Shimat in his best condition, not because of a handicap, there wasn't even a chance to fight. If Shimat had focused on Luna without worrying about the city, she would already be fatally wounded. Shimat was deliberately engaging in close combat with Luna to prevent the city from being destroyed by his great skills.
But Luna's fall was only a matter of time. Shimat only had a few superficial wounds, and they were all healing due to the healing wave.
"You seem to want to destroy yourself, Baekgyeong. Can't you think of running away?"
"It's none of your business."

"Or you must believe that your sister will come to save you. But the fact that I came personally means that spatial leaps in this area are blocked. If True Runekandel wants to come here, it'll take at least eight hours. Will you still be alive then?"
Luna had not thought of Jin's support at all. The madness of the red power just kept her swinging her sword, and she could not think of anything else.
Only the desire to kill filled Luna completely.
Now that desire to kill had taken on human form. It looked like Luna herself, attacking Shimat.
There were no facial features on the face, and the hand holding the ax-sword had no fingers. Shimat felt disgusted looking at the red power transformed like Luna.
'This power could be dangerous if honed.'
Should I just cut it now? Such a thought crossed Shimat's mind.
'But if it breaks without being honed, rather......'
While Shimat was contemplating, Luna was swinging Krantel fiercely, her face smeared with blood, ash, and dust. Anyone who knew her would find her appearance strange, like a demon.
Luna's breathing began to quicken. The accumulated shock from the bombardment that had been hitting her whole body, and from Shimat's blade, was finally breaking her physical form.
'At this rate, soon only the red power that materialized her form will remain.'
Even if Luna dies now, the red power taking her form will continue to fight for a while.
"Grrrr!"
As Luna tried to lift Krantel with all her might, a sudden dark lightning bolt shot up between them.
"Hey! You idiot, I told you to fight, not fall apart!?"

Eltiet, he was interrupting the battle with a bag full of something on his back. After deflecting Shimat's sword, Eltiet punched Luna in the forehead. Luna almost retaliated even after realizing it was Eltiet.
Even though she was clearly losing her sanity just a moment ago, Luna suddenly felt her mind clear. This was thanks to Eltiot infusing 'Qi' when he slapped Luna's forehead.
“Master?”
“Let's run for now!”
“Yes!”
Luna answered without a moment's hesitation. The madness that had taken over her just a moment ago had completely vanished.
“You old man... I wondered what you were up to, and it turns out you were engaged in petty thievery.”
Shimart cut the bundle that Eltiot was carrying on his back before he could get away. Thud! Parts of public facilities used by the enemy race were spilled and shattered.
“Ah, no! Those were so hard to gather, you damned brute! You’re a rascal who doesn't even respect the elderly!”
“Be quiet.”
Shimart's blade grazed Eltiot's nose. Eltiot rolled backward into Luna's arms, and Luna immediately leaped back to distance herself from Shimart.
Then they ran at full speed without looking back. By now, even Luna realized that if she continued to fight, death would be all that awaited her.
“Master, prepare for neutralization quickly! The shield will come up soon!”
“I’m too tired to do it, just smash it with your brute strength!”
“Do you always have to put it that way?”
“Hurry!”
The airborne fortress and fleets began to form a blockade immediately.
But Shimart did not pursue them himself. A spear floated above Shimart's bracelet, and Rakiman's face appeared.
{Fellow deity! We will lure them to the outskirts of the city while building the blockade and eliminate them.}
At those words, Shimart shook his head.
“No, pretend to pursue them but let them go.”
From the beginning, Shimart had no intention of killing Luna and Eltiot today. He had only momentarily hesitated due to Luna's murderous intent and its potential danger.
But to Shimart, that murderous intent was clearly a double-edged sword.
{What?}

“There are still many other enemies. We don't need to start a full-scale war with the powerful Bamel Alliance just yet. From the beginning, the old man must have known that I would make such a judgment, so he came looking for me. You've grown weak, old man... but you seem to be using your otherwise unused brain.”
Rakiman did not argue with Shimart's order.
{……Understood, fellow deity.}
Shimart ended the video communication and looked down at the scattered parts on the ground.
“It's a bitter era when the great Qingfeng Sect has to undertake such risks for these low-grade parts.”
The moment Shimart crushed the remaining parts under his foot and shrugged his shoulders.
Eltiot was touching the 'core' components hidden in his coat pocket, grinning to himself. From the Solar War to this day, it was the first moment he had beaten Shimart in countless battles.
